name: Mountain Gateway Community College
hand_read_notes: The source-owned four-component degree structure is authoritative. Biology and Natural Resources guided-pathway rows are explicitly excluded because no Computer Science guided schedule is published.

degree_context.variant: Generic multi-pathway Science A.S. explicitly configured to support the Transfer Virginia Computer Science pathway; no CS-specific prescribed course branch
degree_context.general_education_authority: Mountain Gateway Uniform Certificate of General Studies, Science Specialized Requirements, and Transfer Core

residency.rule: Twenty-five percent of the degree credits, excluding advanced-placement and credit-by-exam credit, must be acquired at Mountain Gateway Community College.

modeling_notes: The college expressly names Computer Science as one of several Transfer Virginia pathways supported by this generic Science A.S.; it does not publish a CS-only award, specialization, or prescribed CSC sequence.
The canonical 60-credit path uses the published component minima: one SDV credit, 31 UCGS credits, 12 Science Specialized credits, and 16 Transfer Core credits.

The linked UCGS and Science Specialized records preserve all locally listed concrete options. The Science Specialized rule also permits other destination-appropriate Transfer Virginia STEM courses, and Transfer Core remains destination-selected.
The Biology and Natural Resources guided pathways are not degree-wide requirements and are excluded from the composition.

data_quality_flags.message: Computer Science is a supported transfer destination, but the college publishes no CS-specific prescribed course branch.
Science Specialized and Transfer Core selections must be aligned with the receiving program through Transfer Virginia or advising.
The UCGS publishes a 31-33 total even though the locally listed five-credit MTH 167 and six-to-eight-credit Block VII menus can arithmetically exceed 33; the degree component cap remains 33.
